Lead complex DR exercises and technical recovery activities, including troubleshooting failures, identifying root causes, and driving remediation. Assess application and infrastructure architectures for recoverability and alignment with established RTO and RPO requirements. Develop engineering standards, reusable patterns, and technical best practices for resilient and recoverable solutions. Design and develop advanced automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies to improve DR testing, orchestration, validation, and recovery. Partner with cloud, infrastructure, application, security, database, storage, and network engineering teams to incorporate recovery requirements into technology designs. Provide technical leadership and guidance during significant outages and recovery events. Identify material technical recovery risks and drive remediation with appropriate engineering and application teams. Evaluate emerging disaster recovery and resilience technologies and recommend improvements to the firm's recovery capabilities. Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance to technology teams on disaster recovery engineering practices. We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure architecture and disaster recovery capabilities, including designing solutions to meet RTO and RPO requirements. Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting/automation technologies used to automate infrastructure, testing, validation, or recovery processes. Deep understanding of infrastructure components including networking, storage, compute, virtualization, operating systems, databases, and cloud services.
